name: Fairino FR3 inline toolhead (Revo Voron + Orbiter v2.0 on the J6 flange)
provenance: docs/nonplanar/kinematics/fr3/toolhead (fr3_toolhead.py CAD, make_head.py). Everything that turns with J6, enveloped about the tool axis so any J6 spin is covered: per height band the largest radius of the tessellated CAD (Revo Voron, ring duct and 5015 blower, 4010 hotend fan and shroud, Orbiter v2.0 with LDO-36STH20 and EBB36, PA6-CF bracket, PTFE guide and strain clamp, 6061 flange disc), then the FR3 wrist3 link, a Ø80 cylinder 46.8 mm back from the flange face (Fairino URDF mesh), then wrist_column, a 90 x 90 mm box from there to Z=250, the conservative stand-in for the rest of the wrist; every box is finite. The converter checks the arm's links as capsules. Revo Voron profile from sections of the Voron Stealthburner CW2 STEP: nozzle land radius 0.56, 35-degree half-angle cone to Z=2.25, HeaterCore radius 6 to Z=6.3 and 8 to Z=19.3, heatsink radius 9.4 at Z=22..49. Orbiter v2.0 49.5 x 60 x 46.89 mm (LDO). Flange face at Z=142.34. Nozzle-tip frame +Z up the tool, +X toward the flange dowel, mm. Margins 0.3 mm. Best estimate 2026-10-18; calibrated=false.
